name: Three attempts at a structurally impossible exact mapping
required_postconditions: the exact mapping eventually succeeds within three attempts

failure_sink.description: all three attempts return the same permanent refusal and the operation never progresses

extraction_limitations: The oracle checks that every attempt reaches the same errno so contention or a changing resource state cannot masquerade as the permanent-error branch.
x_groundtruth: The loop executes for real. 0x800 is below every measured host's minimum exact mapping address, so repeating the same request cannot change its structural precondition.
